findingDispositions.rationale: The parent-applied schema default now uses прекращение хранения, not передача. The current exact catalog bytes and fresh generated family contain that correction for all eleven actual source memberships, with no shadowing overrides. Current source confirms release is termination of named local holding, separate from send/receive. The complete corrected sentence preserves all other distinctions and placeholders. Closure is broader than original sampled key but limited to this complete family.

sourceEvidence.observation: TGS-request purpose explains only target issuance and excludes NTLM trust/referral semantics; per-scenario IDs derive from suffix. The purpose suffix names acquisition/release and permission not possession.
acquire creates named holding; release emits op:release by holdingId. Wire send/receive are separate operations. receiptOnly receives into temporary message inbox and then releases that holding.
Initial TGS request created by winClient with readers winClient/winDC, sent winClient to winDC and receiptOnly:true. No inferred forwarding or later authorization.
All eleven named memberships are Kerberos scenario presets sharing the initial request producer; later binding/logon/second-hop modes and failures do not change this field purpose.
